# Palkeoramix decompiler. 

def storage:
  owner is address at storage 0
  bountyArbiter is array of struct at storage 1
  fulfillment is array of struct at storage 2
  stor3 is mapping of uint256 at storage 3
  bountyToken is mapping of address at storage 4

def getBountyToken(uint256 _bountyId): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  return bountyToken[_bountyId]

def getNumBounties(): # not payable
  return bountyArbiter.length

def getBountyArbiter(uint256 _bountyId): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  return address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1024)

def owner(): # not payable
  return owner

def getBountyData(uint256 _bountyId): # not payable
  return uint256(stor[(6 * _bountyId) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2][0 len stor[(6 * _bountyId) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2].length].field_0)

def getFulfillment(uint256 _bountyId, uint256 _fulfillmentId): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  mem[160] = uint256(stor[sha3((2 * _fulfillmentId) + ('map', ('param', '_bountyId'), ('name', 'fulfillment', 2)) + 1)].field_0)
  idx = 160
  s = 0
  while stor[(2 * _fulfillmentId) + ('map', ('param', '_bountyId'), ('name', 'fulfillment', 2)) + 1].length + 128 > idx:
      mem[idx + 32] = uint256(stor[s + sha3((2 * _fulfillmentId) + ('map', ('param', '_bountyId'), ('name', 'fulfillment', 2)) + 1)].field_256)
      idx = idx + 32
      s = s + 1
      continue 
  return bool(uint8(fulfillment[_bountyId][_fulfillmentId].field_0)), 
         address(fulfillment[_bountyId][_fulfillmentId].field_0),
         Array(len=stor[(2 * _fulfillmentId) + ('map', ('param', '_bountyId'), ('name', 'fulfillment', 2)) + 1].length, data=mem[160 len stor[(2 * _fulfillmentId) + ('map', ('param', '_bountyId'), ('name', 'fulfillment', 2)) + 1].length])

def bounties(uint256 _param1): # not payable
  require _param1 < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[_param1].field_1192) <= 2
  mem[384] = uint256(stor[sha3((6 * _param1) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2)].field_0)
  idx = 384
  s = 0
  while stor[(6 * _param1) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2].length + 384 > idx + 32:
      mem[idx + 32] = uint256(stor[s + sha3((6 * _param1) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2)].field_256)
      idx = idx + 32
      s = s + 1
      continue 
  return address(bountyArbiter[_param1].field_0), 
         uint256(bountyArbiter[_param1].field_256),
         Array(len=stor[(6 * _param1) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2].length, data=mem[384 len stor[(6 * _param1) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2].length + (floor32(stor[(6 * _param1) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2].length - 1) + -stor[(6 * _param1) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2].length + 32 % 32)]),
         uint256(bountyArbiter[_param1].field_768),
         address(bountyArbiter[_param1].field_1024),
         bool(uint8(bountyArbiter[_param1].field_1184)),
         uint8(bountyArbiter[_param1].field_1024),
         uint256(bountyArbiter[_param1].field_1280)

def getBounty(uint256 nodeIndex): # not payable
  require nodeIndex < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[nodeIndex].field_1192) <= 2
  require nodeIndex < bountyArbiter.length
  return address(bountyArbiter[nodeIndex].field_0), 
         uint256(bountyArbiter[nodeIndex].field_256),
         uint256(bountyArbiter[nodeIndex].field_768),
         bool(uint8(bountyArbiter[nodeIndex].field_1184)),
         uint8(bountyArbiter[nodeIndex].field_1192),
         uint256(bountyArbiter[nodeIndex].field_1280)

def getNumFulfillments(uint256 _bountyId): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  return uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)

#
#  Regular functions
#

def _fallback(?) payable: # default function
  revert

def transferIssuer(uint256 _bountyId, address _newIssuer): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require caller == address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0) = _newIssuer
  log IssuerTransferred(
        uint256 _bountyId=_bountyId,
        address _newIssuer=_newIssuer)

def extendDeadline(uint256 _bountyId, uint256 _newDeadline): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require caller == address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require _newDeadline > uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_256)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_256) = _newDeadline
  log DeadlineExtended(
        uint256 bountyId=_bountyId,
        uint256 newDeadline=_newDeadline)

def changeBountyArbiter(uint256 _bountyId, address _newArbiter): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require caller == address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192) <= 2
  require not uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1024) = _newArbiter
  log BountyChanged(uint256 bountyId=_bountyId)

def changeBountyFulfillmentAmount(uint256 _bountyId, uint256 _newFulfillmentAmount): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require caller == address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192) <= 2
  require not uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_768) = _newFulfillmentAmount
  log BountyChanged(uint256 bountyId=_bountyId)

def changeBountyDeadline(uint256 _bountyId, uint256 _newDeadline): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require caller == address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _newDeadline > block.timestamp
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192) <= 2
  require not uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_256) = _newDeadline
  log BountyChanged(uint256 bountyId=_bountyId)

def changeBountyData(uint256 _bountyId, string _newData): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require caller == address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192) <= 2
  require not uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint256(stor[sha3((6 * _bountyId) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2)][].field_0) = Array(len=_newData.length, data=_newData[all])
  log BountyChanged(uint256 bountyId=_bountyId)

def updateFulfillment(uint256 _bountyId, uint256 _fulfillmentId, string _data): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  require caller == address(fulfillment[_bountyId][_fulfillmentId].field_8)
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  require not uint8(fulfillment[_bountyId][_fulfillmentId].field_0)
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  uint256(stor[sha3((2 * _fulfillmentId) + ('map', ('param', '_bountyId'), ('name', 'fulfillment', 2)) + 1)][].field_0) = Array(len=_data.length, data=_data[all])
  log FulfillmentUpdated(
        uint256 _bountyId=_bountyId,
        uint256 _fulfillmentId=_fulfillmentId)

def killBounty(uint256 _bountyId): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require caller == address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192) = 2
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1280) = 0
  if uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1280) > 0:
      require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
      require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
      if not uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1184):
          call address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0) with:
             value uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1280) wei
               gas 2300 * is_zero(value) wei
          require ext_call.success
      else:
          require ext_code.size(bountyToken[_bountyId])
          call bountyToken[_bountyId].transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) with:
               gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
              args address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0), uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1280)
          require ext_call.success
          require ext_call.return_data[0]
  log BountyKilled(
        uint256 bountyId=_bountyId,
        address issuer=caller)

def contribute(uint256 amount, uint256 commune) payable: 
  require amount < bountyArbiter.length
  require block.timestamp < uint256(bountyArbiter[amount].field_256)
  require amount < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[amount].field_1192) <= 2
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[amount].field_1192) != 2
  require commune
  require amount < bountyArbiter.length
  if not uint8(bountyArbiter[amount].field_1184):
      require commune == call.value
  else:
      require not call.value
      require ext_code.size(bountyToken[amount])
      call bountyToken[amount].balanceOf(address account) with:
           gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
          args this.address
      require ext_call.success
      require ext_code.size(bountyToken[amount])
      if commune:
          call bountyToken[amount].transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) with:
               gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
              args caller, address(this.address), commune
          require ext_call.success
          require ext_call.return_data[0]
      call bountyToken[amount].balanceOf(address account) with:
           gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
          args this.address
      require ext_call.success
      require not commune
  require amount < bountyArbiter.length
  uint256(bountyArbiter[amount].field_1280) += commune
  log ContributionAdded(
        uint256 bountyId=amount,
        address contributor=commune,
        uint256 value=caller)

def increasePayout(uint256 _bountyId, uint256 _newFulfillmentAmount, uint256 _value) payable: 
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require caller == address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_768) < _newFulfillmentAmount
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  if not uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1184):
      require _value == call.value
  else:
      require not call.value
      require ext_code.size(bountyToken[_bountyId])
      call bountyToken[_bountyId].balanceOf(address account) with:
           gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
          args this.address
      require ext_call.success
      require ext_code.size(bountyToken[_bountyId])
      if _value:
          call bountyToken[_bountyId].transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) with:
               gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
              args caller, address(this.address), _value
          require ext_call.success
          require ext_call.return_data[0]
      call bountyToken[_bountyId].balanceOf(address account) with:
           gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
          args this.address
      require ext_call.success
      require not _value
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1280) += _value
  require uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1280) >= _newFulfillmentAmount
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_768) = _newFulfillmentAmount
  log PayoutIncreased(
        uint256 _bountyId=_bountyId,
        uint256 _newFulfillmentAmount=_newFulfillmentAmount)

def activateBounty(uint256 _bountyId, uint256 _value) payable: 
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require block.timestamp < uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_256)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require caller == address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  if not uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1184):
      require _value == call.value
  else:
      require not call.value
      require ext_code.size(bountyToken[_bountyId])
      call bountyToken[_bountyId].balanceOf(address account) with:
           gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
          args this.address
      require ext_call.success
      require ext_code.size(bountyToken[_bountyId])
      if _value:
          call bountyToken[_bountyId].transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) with:
               gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
              args caller, address(this.address), _value
          require ext_call.success
          require ext_call.return_data[0]
      call bountyToken[_bountyId].balanceOf(address account) with:
           gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
          args this.address
      require ext_call.success
      require not _value
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1280) += _value
  require uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1280) >= uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_768)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192) = 1
  log ContributionAdded(
        uint256 bountyId=_bountyId,
        address contributor=_value,
        uint256 value=caller)
  log BountyActivated(
        uint256 bountyId=_bountyId,
        address issuer=caller)

def acceptFulfillment(uint256 _bountyId, uint256 _fulfillmentId): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  if address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0) != caller:
      require caller == address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1024)
      require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
      require address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1024)
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192) <= 2
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192) == 1
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  require not uint8(fulfillment[_bountyId][_fulfillmentId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1280) >= uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_768)
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  uint8(fulfillment[_bountyId][_fulfillmentId].field_0) = 1
  stor3[_bountyId]++
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1280) -= uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_768)
  require _fulfillmentId < uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  if not uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1184):
      call address(fulfillment[_bountyId][_fulfillmentId].field_8) with:
         value uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_768) wei
           gas 2300 * is_zero(value) wei
      require ext_call.success
  else:
      require ext_code.size(bountyToken[_bountyId])
      call bountyToken[_bountyId].transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) with:
           gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
          args address(fulfillment[_bountyId][_fulfillmentId].field_0), uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_768)
      require ext_call.success
      require ext_call.return_data[0]
  log FulfillmentAccepted(
        uint256 bountyId=_bountyId,
        address fulfiller=caller,
        uint256 _fulfillmentId=_fulfillmentId)

def issueBounty(address _issuer, uint256 _deadline, string _data, uint256 _fulfillmentAmount, address _arbiter, bool _paysTokens, address _tokenContract): # not payable
  require _deadline > block.timestamp
  require _fulfillmentAmount
  require bountyArbiter.length + 1 > bountyArbiter.length
  bountyArbiter.length++
  if not bountyArbiter.length <= bountyArbiter.length + 1:
      mem[0] = 1
      idx = (6 * bountyArbiter.length) + 6
      while sha3(1) + (6 * bountyArbiter.length) > idx + sha3(mem[0]):
          address(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0])].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 1].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2].field_0) = 0
          if 31 < stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2].length:
              mem[0] = idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2
              s = sha3(idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2)
              while sha3(idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2) + (stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2].length + 31 / 32) > s:
                  uint256(stor[s].field_0) = 0
                  s = s + 1
                  continue 
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 3].field_0) = 0
          address(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 4].field_0) = 0
          uint8(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 4].field_160) = 0
          uint8(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 4].field_168) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 5].field_0) = 0
          idx = idx + 6
          continue 
  address(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_0) = _issuer
  uint256(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_256) = _deadline
  uint256(stor[sha3((6 * bountyArbiter.length) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2)][].field_0) = Array(len=_data.length, data=_data[all])
  uint256(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_768) = _fulfillmentAmount
  address(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_1024) = _arbiter
  Mask(96, 0, bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_1184) = Mask(96, 0, _paysTokens)
  uint8(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_1192) = 0
  bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_1280 % 1 = 0
  uint256(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_1280) = 0
  if _paysTokens:
      bountyToken[stor1.length - 1] = _tokenContract
  log BountyIssued(uint256 bountyId=(bountyArbiter.length - 1))
  return (bountyArbiter.length - 1)

def fulfillBounty(uint256 _bountyId, string _data): # not payable
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0) + 1 > uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192) <= 2
  require uint8(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1192) == 1
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require block.timestamp < uint256(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_256)
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_0) != caller
  require _bountyId < bountyArbiter.length
  require address(bountyArbiter[_bountyId].field_1024) != caller
  uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)++
  if not uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0) <= uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0) + 1:
      mem[0] = sha3(_bountyId, 2)
      idx = 2 * uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0) + 1
      while sha3(sha3(_bountyId, 2)) + (2 * uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)) > idx + sha3(mem[0]):
          uint8(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0])].field_0) = 0
          address(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0])].field_8) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 1].field_0) = 0
          if 31 < stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 1].length:
              mem[0] = idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 1
              s = sha3(idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 1)
              while sha3(idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 1) + (stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 1].length + 31 / 32) > s:
                  uint256(stor[s].field_0) = 0
                  s = s + 1
                  continue 
          idx = idx + 2
          continue 
  uint8(fulfillment[_bountyId][uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)].field_0) = 0
  address(fulfillment[_bountyId][uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)].field_8) = caller
  uint256(stor[sha3((2 * uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0)) + ('map', ('param', '_bountyId'), ('name', 'fulfillment', 2)) + 1)][].field_0) = Array(len=_data.length, data=_data[all])
  log BountyFulfilled(
        uint256 bountyId=_bountyId,
        address fulfiller=caller,
        uint256 _fulfillmentId=uint256(fulfillment[_bountyId].field_0) - 1)

def issueAndActivateBounty(address _issuer, uint256 _deadline, string _data, uint256 _fulfillmentAmount, address _arbiter, bool _paysTokens, address _tokenContract, uint256 _value) payable: 
  require _deadline > block.timestamp
  require _fulfillmentAmount
  require bountyArbiter.length + 1 > bountyArbiter.length
  require _value >= _fulfillmentAmount
  if not _paysTokens:
      require _value == call.value
  else:
      require not call.value
      bountyToken[stor1.length] = _tokenContract
      require ext_code.size(bountyToken[stor1.length])
      call bountyToken[stor1.length].transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) with:
           gas gas_remaining - 710 wei
          args caller, address(this.address), _value
      require ext_call.success
      require ext_call.return_data[0]
  bountyArbiter.length++
  if not bountyArbiter.length <= bountyArbiter.length + 1:
      mem[0] = 1
      idx = (6 * bountyArbiter.length) + 6
      while sha3(1) + (6 * bountyArbiter.length) > idx + sha3(mem[0]):
          address(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0])].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 1].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2].field_0) = 0
          if 31 < stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2].length:
              mem[0] = idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2
              s = sha3(idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2)
              while sha3(idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2) + (stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2].length + 31 / 32) > s:
                  uint256(stor[s].field_0) = 0
                  s = s + 1
                  continue 
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 3].field_0) = 0
          address(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 4].field_0) = 0
          uint8(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 4].field_160) = 0
          uint8(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 4].field_168) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 5].field_0) = 0
          idx = idx + 6
          continue 
  address(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_0) = _issuer
  uint256(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_256) = _deadline
  uint256(stor[sha3((6 * bountyArbiter.length) + ('name', 'bountyArbiter', 1) + 2)][].field_0) = Array(len=_data.length, data=_data[all])
  uint256(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_768) = _fulfillmentAmount
  address(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_1024) = _arbiter
  Mask(96, 0, bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_1184) = Mask(96, 0, _paysTokens)
  uint8(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_1192) = 1
  uint256(bountyArbiter[bountyArbiter.length].field_1280) = _value
  log BountyIssued(uint256 bountyId=(bountyArbiter.length - 1))
  log ContributionAdded(
        uint256 bountyId=bountyArbiter.length - 1,
        address contributor=_value,
        uint256 value=caller)
  log BountyActivated(
        uint256 bountyId=bountyArbiter.length - 1,
        address issuer=caller)
  return (bountyArbiter.length - 1)
